units.source_text: 打听得九条地方还有一个昔年相识之人，便以他家作为住宿之处。

en.t: They heard that in the Kujo district there was still someone they had known in former days, so they made that person's house their lodging.

units.source_text: 九条虽说是京都之内，但非上流人所居之地，周围都是些走市场的女子和商人。

en.t: Although Kujo was within Kyoto, it was not a place where people of high rank lived; all around were market women and merchants.

units.source_text: 他们混在其中，郁郁不乐地度日，不觉已经到了秋天。

en.t: They lived among such people, passing their days in gloom, and before they knew it autumn had arrived.

units.source_text: 回思往事，缅想将来，可悲之事甚多。

en.t: When they looked back on the past and thought ahead to the future, there was much to grieve over.

units.source_text: 众人所依靠的丰后介，如今好比蛟龙失水，一筹莫展。

en.t: Bungo no Suke, on whom they all depended, was now like a dragon stranded without water, utterly at a loss.

units.source_text: 他在这陌生地方找不到出路，百无聊赖；

en.t: In this unfamiliar place he could find no way forward and had nothing to relieve his despondency;

units.source_text: 回到筑紫肥前去呢，又没有面子。

en.t: yet if he returned to Hizen in Tsukushi, he would lose face.

units.source_text: 不免懊悔此行太孟浪了。

en.t: He could not help regretting that this journey had been far too rash.

units.source_text: 跟他同来的仆从，大都托故离去，逃回故乡了。

en.t: Most of the servants who had come with him made excuses to leave and fled back to their homes.

units.source_text: 母夫人看见生活如此不安，朝朝暮暮悲伤叹息，又觉得委屈了这儿子。

en.t: Seeing how unsettled their life had become, his mother grieved and sighed morning and evening, and felt that her son had been wronged by it all.

units.source_text: 丰后介安慰她道：“母亲何必伤心！

en.t: Bungo no Suke comforted her, saying, "Mother, why should you grieve?

units.source_text: 我此一身，诚不足道。

en.t: My own life is truly of no importance.

units.source_text: 为了小姐一人，我身即使赴汤蹈火，亦不足惜。

en.t: For the young lady alone, even if I had to go through boiling water and fire, I would not begrudge this body.

units.source_text: 反之，纵令我等升官发财，但教小姐嫁与这种蠢汉，我等又岂能安心呢？”

en.t: On the other hand, even if we gained office and wealth, how could we ever be at peace if the young lady were made to marry such a foolish man?"

units.source_text: 后来又说：“神佛定能引导小姐，使她得福。

en.t: Later he also said, "The gods and buddhas will surely guide the young lady and bring her happiness.

units.source_text: 附近有个八幡神庙，和小姐在外乡所参拜的松浦神庙及箱崎神庙，所祀的是同一神明。

en.t: There is a Hachiman shrine nearby, and it enshrines the same deity as the Matsura and Hakozaki shrines that the young lady worshiped while she was away from the capital.

units.source_text: 小姐离去该地时，曾向此神立下许多誓愿，因此蒙神呵护，得以平安返京。

en.t: When the young lady left that place, she made many vows to this god, and through the god's protection she was able to return safely to Kyoto.

units.source_text: 今当即速前往参拜。”

en.t: Now we should go at once to worship there."

units.source_text: 便劝她们往八幡神庙进香。

en.t: Thus he urged the women to go and pay their respects at the Hachiman shrine.

units.source_text: 向熟悉情况的人打听一下，知道这庙里有一个知客僧，早先曾经亲近太宰少弍，现在还活着。

en.t: After asking someone who knew the situation, they learned that there was a guest-master monk at the shrine who had once been close to the Dazai no Shoni and was still alive.

units.source_text: 便把这知客僧唤来，叫他引导，前往进香。

en.t: They summoned this guest-master monk, had him guide them, and went to make their offering of worship.
